note: Triennial election of the 23 district electoral divisions of Ballymena rural district, one member each (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924). Polling in the four contested divisions (Ahoghill, Ballyscullion, Galgorm and Kirkinriola) took place on Thursday 5 June 1924 and the results were declared on 6 June. Eighteen divisions were returned unopposed, several after withdrawals (Ballymena Observer, 9 and 16 May 1924, p. 10). Glenbuck had no nomination; the new council co-opted Samuel Shaw as its member on 10 June 1924 (Ballymena Observer, 13 June 1924, p. 6), which is not an election and is not recorded as a result. Sole nomination; sitting member. Citation restored to the original page: the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated page (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page images of the Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924, p. 2, and the Ballymena Observer, 16 May 1924, p. 10 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the surname Reily is Reilly, as the Observer prints it (A. C. Reilly).
